title: Total gate-count bound
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, define $T(n,k)=c(n,k)+2^{n-k}$, where subtraction is truncated natural-number subtraction and $c(n,k)=f(n,k)+2^{2^k}$, with $f(n,k)=z(n,k)+(2^{k+1}-1)$ and $z(n,k)=n+(2^{n-k+1}-1)$.
